pretreatments.description: Subcritical water pretreatment was performed on açai residue using a semi-continuous flow unit (batch to solid and continuous to liquid) in a stainless steel hydrolysis reactor (110 mL) under temperature conditions of 170 and 200 °C. The system maintained a water flow rate of 20 mL min^-1 and operating pressure of 15 MPa (maximum working conditions are 400 °C and 42 MPa). A mass ratio of 80 g water per g of açai seed was used. The hydrolysis residence time was evaluated at 20 minutes for both conditions. Post-treatment analysis included pH, reducing sugars, organic acids, and inhibitors.
